html:
SMTO-LLM-0015 — The model ran out of room before finishing its reply

GUID: ad3a5d14-7cb0-4422-ba5d-e00f6218fc67
Slug: model-output-truncated
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: provider

What happened

  • The model hit its output limit while writing an answer or action, so the reply was cut off. SMTO didn't carry out the half-written action.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Below the message box, raise the Output limit slider (select Controls if you don't see it), then ask SMTO to continue in a new message. The Output limit is how much the model may write in one reply, and it applies to new messages in this conversation.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing, open the Main card, and expand Limits and recovery. Raise Output allowance and select Save Main. This raises the room for all new work; it also leaves slightly less room for the conversation itself.
  3. Or ask for the work in smaller parts, for example one file or one section at a time. Shorter replies fit within the current limit without changing any settings.

What success looks like

  • The model's reply finishes and the task moves on to its next step.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO's model settings. Setting the limit higher than the model can handle won't help, and SMTO refuses an output limit as large as the model's whole context.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The provider finished with finish_reason "length" while answer text or tool-call fragments were present, so the truncated decision was rejected before any tool authorization (model_output_truncated).

What this means

  • The provider’s finish reason reports that generation reached its output allowance while response text or tool fragments were present. That is an output truncation, not proof that input capacity was exceeded. The partial result cannot replace a complete validated tool decision.

Why this can happen

  • The response finish_reason is length and some answer or tool-call characters are present.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the captured output allowance with the input budget. More reserved output leaves less room for input; check both before changing the new task’s settings.

How to fix it

  • Automatic output increases (Settings › Setup › Model routing › Automatic budget increases) were used up, turned off or did not apply to this call. Raise the role's Output allowance (max_tokens / max_completion_tokens) or the composer Output limit, keeping it below the context window, or split the work. Don't raise output tokens to address an input-context overflow; a larger output reservation leaves less room for input.
  • Consider increasing Mission Control → Model Configuration → Maximum completion tokens. Reserving more output leaves less context for input/history.

Relevant SMTO settings

  • Open Maximum Completion Tokens: model-configuration / max_completion_tokens. Applies to: new task.
  • Start a new task after changing this setting. Active and resumed tasks retain their captured values.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A new task’s response ends with a supported completion reason and a complete answer or tool call.

What not to do

  • Do not increase output tokens as the first response to protected input overflow.

Technical notes

  • The current decision is rejected before tool authorization when enforcement applies; earlier results are not replayed.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0002 — A step's results were too large to send to the model
  • SMTO-CTX-0005 — Your request and the model's answer won't fit together
  • SMTO-LLM-0001 — Model request timed out
  • SMTO-EXE-0005 — A command ran too long and SMTO stopped it
  • SMTO-LLM-0037 — An older retry attempt ran out of time
  • SMTO-CTX-0001 — The AI model said your request was too long for it
